# SEO Content Recommendations

**Status:** recommendations only. No item below has been approved or implemented. This portfolio's current visible design and content are the baseline. Do not create a page, edit visible copy, add navigation, or change a user journey without the site owner's explicit approval.

|---|---|---|
| Homepage (`/`) | Learn who Geni Waruni Bahar / Waruni Bahar is; Auckland context; her QA, education, cloud/security interests, experience and credentials; connect with her. | Unique person-first title/description, canonical, Person/ProfilePage/WebSite graph and social metadata. |

The content supports branded and specific project-topic discovery. It does not claim broad enterprise security experience, live commercial service delivery, or ranking for generic how-to queries. Search volumes, difficulty, current position and traffic are not available and are not estimated here.

## External actions and evidence needed

- Verify `genibahar.com` in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools after an authorized deployment. Use actual query, impression, click and indexing data to decide whether any content opportunity addresses real visitor intent.
- Confirm that the owner-controlled public profile URLs are current and represent the same person before changing `sameAs` or requesting reciprocal links.
- Ask Geni to supply or approve personal reflections, work examples, dates and any additional qualifications before adding them. Do not infer hobbies, expertise, outcomes, testimonials or business capability from search snippets.
- Reassess competing public portfolio pages only as qualitative examples. Do not treat result ordering, snippets or external tools as reliable rank, volume or difficulty data without an appropriate measurement source.

## Out of scope unless separately approved

New FAQ or service pages, job-search/role-targeted landing pages, LocalBusiness markup, new navigation items, visual breadcrumb components, blog infrastructure, analytics identifiers and changes to public profile content are not recommended for automatic implementation. Do not add hidden keyword text, unsupported schema, or content that exists only for a crawler.
